acceptance: Probe mode cannot upload to TestPyPI or PyPI, create attestations, or push tags or releases (asserted by test: no publish-action or attest step executes when probe=true; id-token permission absent in probe)
Running probe mode against the #3947 graph (before #3956) fails because publish did not run, a regression test kept as a fixture
Probe runs in under 15 minutes and holds at most 4 runners
A PR touching release-v2.yml shows the probe job, and it is listed in the required-check documentation (setting change prepared for the owner if one is needed)
Both evidence variants (reuse and fallback) execute in probe and reach publish dry-run
context: Member of batch release-v2-remediation. GUARDRAILS: probe must be structurally incapable of publishing (no id-token: write, no upload step); never route probe through the pypi or test-pypi environments. DECISION GATE: making the probe job a required status check is a repository-settings change; prepare it and ask the owner.
description: The #3947 publish-skip bug passed unit tests (one asserted the broken shape), local and hosted oracle review, and was found only by a 3-hour live run. Add a probe mode: release-v2 runs with the real job graph and conditions, but admit uses a synthetic probe target (no tag ruleset needed), UAT shards are stubs that emit valid evidence for the stub digest, the evidence-check path (rv2r-03) is exercised in both reuse and fallback variants, and publish runs as a dry run (download admitted files, verify SHA256SUMS, twine check; no upload, no attestation). A PR-triggered job runs probe mode whenever .github/workflows/release-v2.yml, scripts/release_*.py or the release-uat-env action change, and it is required for those PRs.
